name: Tazmo Co., Ltd.
summary: Tazmo Co., Ltd., together with subsidiaries engages in the development, manufacturing, and sales of semiconductor manufacturing equipment in Japan, Taiwan, China, South Korea, Vietnam, rest of Asia, North America, and Europe. It operates in three segments: Process Equipment Business; Mold and Resin Molding Business; and Surface Treatment Equipment Business. The company offers semiconductor manufacturing equipment, including bonders/debonders, cleaning systems, CMP slurry distribution systems, coaters/developers, and phosphoric acid reclamation process equipment; clean transfer equipment, such as atmospheric and vacuum robots, and pre aligners; and nanoimprint fully automated mass production …
